## About this dashboard
Controlled Drugs (CDs) listed under Schedule 5 of the Misuse of Drugs Regulations include certain codeine, pholcodine, or morphine. While these medicines have legitimate clinical uses, they also carry risks of misuse and dependency.

 This dashboard provides visibility into prescribing patterns for Schedule 5 Controlled Drugs across practices and prescribers. It highlights the volume and cost of these items, enabling Sub-Integrated Care Board Locations (SICBLs) and other stakeholders to monitor trends, identify outliers, and support safe prescribing practices.

 By surfacing this data, the dashboard helps inform targeted reviews, compliance with controlled drug regulations, and opportunities to reduce inappropriate prescribing, ensuring patient safety and cost-effective use of NHS resources.
